tools.description: Change a canvas in one transaction (opens its tab in the background if needed). Returns {applied, ids, errors}. Ops: {op:'add', shape:{type:'sticky'|'text'|'frame'|'arrow'|'image'|'link'|'checklist'|'timeline', id?, x?, y?, w?, h?, color?, text?|title?|url?|from?/to?|label?}} (omit x/y to place it in free space near the view; give it your own id, e.g. 'n1', to connect it later in the same call). A link with live:true (or type:'web') shows the site itself on the board, an iframe everyone on the board can browse — each person signed in as themselves; it defaults to 960×640 and needs an http(s) url; update {live:false} turns it back into a card. A checklist is a clickable RSVP / to-do card: {type:'checklist', title, columns?:['Yes','No'] (1–4; one column = to-do boxes), rows:['Ann', …] (≤60), picks?:{'Ann':'Yes'}, notes?:{'Ann':'Back at 6'}, assignees?:{'Fix login':['Grace Hopper','ann@example.com']}} — it is stored as a sticky with view:'checklist' whose text is the list ('### Title' then '- [ ] Ann' / '- [x] Ann · No' lines, a row's comment as indented '  > …' lines under it, then one indented '  @Name' line per assignee), so older Coppers show it as a note with task boxes; each row has at most one pick and one comment (multi-line text, shown collapsed under the row) and up to 12 assignees (people on the canvas named by name, email or id — each newly assigned one is notified like a chat @mention; anyone else by a name of their own); in update, picks, notes and assignees name a row by label, null clears it (assignees replace the row's list), and rows/columns/title replace them in the text (rows keep their picks, comments and assignees by label). {op:'update', id, patch:{view:'checklist', columns?}} turns a sticky that holds a heading and a task list into a card, ticks kept; view:null turns it back into a note. A timeline: {type:'timeline', title?, start:'YYYY-MM-DD', end, step?:'day'|'week'|'month'|'quarter'|'year', items?:[{date, end?, label, text?, color?}]} (text makes a bubble, end a section), stored as a sticky with view:'timeline' whose text is the timeline; update takes the same (items replaces the list) plus addItems:[…] and editItems:{ref: patch|null} (ref: 'YYYY-MM-DD · label', a label, a date or an index; null removes). {op:'update', id, patch:{…}}; {op:'move', id, dx, dy}; {op:'resize', id, w, h}; {op:'delete', id}; {op:'connect', from:id, to:id, label?} (an arrow); comment threads on a shape, Figma-style: {op:'comment', on:shapeId, text} starts one (its ids[i] is the thread id), {op:'reply', thread, text} adds onto one (a resolved thread opens again), {op:'resolve', thread, resolved:true|false} resolves or reopens; {op:'clear', confirm:true} only when the user explicitly asked to wipe the board.
